description.fun: Azurill bounces around on the big ball at the end of its tail, which is packed with the nutrients it needs to grow and doubles as a float when it swims. Swung like a lasso, the ball can fling its body ten metres. Until Generation 6, one in three female Azurill turned into a male Marill on evolving, something no other Pokémon does.
description.guide: A small, round baby Pokémon of the Normal and Fairy types (pure Normal before Generation 6), introduced in Generation 3 as the first stage of Marill's family. Its large, bouncy tail ball stores nutrients and helps it float. It evolves into Marill when it is very friendly with its Trainer.
description.tagline: Bounces on a tail ball as big as itself

description.fun: Before Gold and Silver came out, fans spent months calling Marill 'Pikablu', sure it was a blue Pikachu, and the nickname even made it onto trading cards. Its tail ball is full of oil that keeps it afloat like a buoy, and its water-repellent fur dries the moment it leaves the water, so it never gets cold.
description.guide: A small, round, mouse-like Pokémon of the Water and Fairy types (pure Water before Generation 6). The oil-filled ball on its tail keeps it afloat and its fur repels water. It evolves from Azurill and into Azumarill.
description.tagline: The 'Pikablu' fans mistook for a blue Pikachu

description.fun: Azumarill can sit still in a rushing river and find prey just by listening, rolling its long ears up first so the insides stay dry. If it spots a Pokémon drowning, it makes an air bubble so it can breathe. The bubble pattern on its body helps it blend into the water.
description.guide: A rabbit-like Pokémon of the Water and Fairy types (pure Water before Generation 6) and the final form of Azurill. It has excellent hearing, even underwater, and a bubble-patterned body that camouflages it in water. It is known to make air bubbles to help drowning Pokémon.
description.tagline: A water rabbit that hears prey over a rushing river

note.text: Azurill is a baby Pokémon added in Generation 3, a generation after Marill. Because the two had different gender ratios, a third of female Azurill evolved into male Marill until Generation 6; since then Azurill keeps its gender.
